## Many plots

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
set.seed(1)
ggplot(diamonds[sample(nrow(diamonds), 800), ], aes(carat, price, colour = cut)) + geom_point()
```

## Another

ggplot(mpg, aes(class, hwy)) + geom_boxplot()
